info.description: Manual companion to scripts/demo.sh. Set demoPassword from .env. Token: acme.hr starts a new unique demo ID. Uploads require saving an export, choosing the file and setting asOf. Wait for active runs; reject only AWAITING_APPROVAL. HALT/approval/retry requests are deliberate manual actions; do not run the entire collection unattended.
